apps.name: Fluid dynamics
apps.summary: Fluid dynamics is a real-time fluid simulation you paint with your finger. Under the hood it solves the same equations that describe real smoke and water — the Navier–Stokes equations — entirely on the GPU using WebGL2, so thick, swirling dye reacts to every stroke at full frame rate. apps.summary: MIDI Lab is a universal MIDI-controller tester, synthesizer and visual playground.
